ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 35% high-intensity (white) to 65% low-intensity (black) pixel ratio across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two major high-intensity contiguous regions situated centrally on both lobes. The left lobe features an irregular triangular white patch with interior low-intensity mottling. The right lobe features a larger, more rounded white patch containing a prominent dark linear disruption.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch at the center-line; internal angle estimated at approximately 65 degrees with significant pixel-depth relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the entire trailing boundary, characterized by irregular peaks and valleys with pixel-amplitudes varying between 2 and 7 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve profile; exhibiting concavity originating from the median notch transition into a broad convexity towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially distinct clusters of high-intensity circular pixels (3-10 pixel diameter) visible primarily along the leading edges and scattered within the dark pigmented zones.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent dark linear pixel disruption (approx. 45 pixels in length) oriented diagonally on the right high-intensity patch; a smaller, less defined linear mark is visible on the left high-intensity patch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of high-intensity circular markings concentrated along the distal tips and trailing edges of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Complex, high-entropy mottling pattern at the boundary transition between the primary black and white pigmentation zones.
